title: Backend: Unit Tests
description: Create comprehensive unit tests for indicator engine, rule engine, and backtest engine. Test indicator correctness against known values, rule edge cases (crossover boundary, NaN handling, logical composition), and full backtest simulation with synthetic data producing verified outcomes.

criteria: tests/test_strategy_indicators.py: 7+ tests covering MA, MACD, KDJ, BOLL correctness, NaN handling, empty input, dispatcher
tests/test_strategy_rules.py: 10+ tests covering all 6 operators, edge cases, multi-rule combination, NaN handling
tests/test_strategy_engine.py: 9+ tests covering T+1 execution, single position, commission, slippage, share rounding, drawdown, win rate
All tests use unittest framework following existing tests/ patterns
All tests use synthetic data (no external data dependencies)
Indicator tests verify values against hand-calculated references within 0.01% tolerance
Engine tests use known-outcome synthetic scenarios
All tests pass: python -m pytest tests/test_strategy_*.py -v
